en.headline: 12 commits across 2 repos, 2 issues opened upstream, 1 discussion started
en.summary: On 2026-10-16 the user logged **12 commits** across two personal repos, with no pull requests, reviews, or releases. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` there were 7 own commits: adding `AGENTS.md` and noting the origin remote, creating a `knowledge/` base for Git & GitHub findings with Excalidraw sketches, archiving OpenCode V2 distribution/architecture/auth and Windows path notes, archiving oh-my-opencode-slim and hosted OpenCode findings, generalizing the `knowledge` doc to cover various knowledge rather than only Git/GitHub, and making knowledge supplementation a default action with architecture adjustable to content. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` there were 5 own commits plus 12 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`: adding a `--force` flag to the daily CLI to skip the comment-count snapshot freeze and documenting the backfill effect on already-closed dates, fixing `--force` to also re-fetch the finalized day's comment snapshot, removing the `updated_at`-in-window filter on candidate entries, tightening comment-count semantics and target retrieval per review feedback, and fixing a +08 early-morning reply miss while surfacing comment counts on Issue/PR rows.

zh.headline: 2 个仓库共 12 次提交，上游新开 2 个 issue，发起 1 个讨论
zh.summary: 2026-10-16 当天，用户在两个个人仓库共提交 **12 次**，无 PR、无 review、无 release。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 有 7 次本人提交：新增 `AGENTS.md` 并标注 origin remote，建立 `knowledge/` 目录用于归档 Git & GitHub 相关发现并附 Excalidraw 草图，归档 OpenCode V2 分发/架构/认证与 Windows 路径坑，归档 oh-my-opencode-slim 与托管 OpenCode 实测知识，将 `knowledge` 文档泛化为「各种知识」不再限定 Git/GitHub，并把 knowledge 补充改为默认动作、架构可随内容调整。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 有 5 次本人提交，另有 12 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交：为 daily CLI 增加 `--force` 参数以跳过评论数快照冻结并说明重跑已关闭日期的补录效应，修复 `--force` 一并重取定稿日评论数快照，取消候选条目按 `updated_at` 是否落在窗口内的过滤，按复审意见收紧评论数口径与 target 检索，修复 +08 凌晨漏采回复并在 Issue/PR 行显示评论数。用户在 `anomalyco/opencode` 新开 2 个 issue：#55785 报告 `mimo-v2.6-flash` 与 `mimo-v2.5` 声明支持图像输入但 Go 端点拒绝所有图像（400），共 3 条评论，`micahgerges` 用真实 OpenCode Go key 在 `opencode serve 2.0.29` 上确认，`opencode-agent[bot]` 核对了已发布模型元数据；#55772 请求为 Windows 桌面版提供运行其自带 CLI 的方式，共 1 条评论，`opencode-agent[bot]` 已回应。用户还在 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 Ideas 分类下发起讨论 #4982「Share session archive state with OpenCode's own clients」。当天无 release，各采集段均未触及截断上限。
